# PowerFootball-2D — Static Repository Map

**Godot 4.7 · GDScript 2.0 · Top-Down Football Simulation**
"Dwarf Fortress with a football." Simple visuals; deep social simulation.

## Vision & Architecture

- **POWERFOOTBALL_MASTER_VISION.md** — Canonical vision, five-layer stack, roadmap, deep systems design, AI-agent protocol
- **ROADMAP.md** — Tactical `[ ]`/`[x]` feature checklist (5 phases)
- **CLAUDE.md** — Agent entry point; invariants, boot order, contracts

## Core Rules (Immutable)

- **.claude/rules/godot-47-core.md** — Godot 4.7 syntax; forbidden APIs; scene init contracts
- **.claude/rules/soccer-physics.md** — Ball physics formulas; collision matrix; kinematic weight rules
- **.claude/rules/ai-architect.md** — AI time-slicing; zero scene-tree polling; allocation constraints; declarative player spawn

## Spatial & Event System (Choke Points)

- **autoloads/MatchWorldModel.gd** — Spatial position cache; all NPC position reads route here
- **autoloads/GameEvents.gd** — Signal bus; all inter-system events route here
- **autoloads/GameManager.gd** — Match phase, score, clock; set piece flow control

## Player & Ball Physics

- **entities/player/HeavyPlayerController.gd** — Kinematic weight model; stamina; input handling
- **entities/player/PlayerBrain.gd** — Utility-scored AI decisions; decision interval stagger
- **entities/ball/Pseudo3DBall.gd** — Ball physics; z-axis; shadow rendering; friction model

## Data & Decision Systems

- **shared/PlayerData.gd** — Player attributes, traits (planned), relationships (planned)
- **shared/ManagerData.gd** — Manager personality traits; formation library; tactics
- **shared/UtilityMath.gd** — Intercept solver; lane occlusion; sigmoid and lerp helpers
- **shared/CollisionLayers.gd** — Layer constants; read before any physics work

## Data Import

- **docs/json-schema.md** — Complete schema for player, manager, team, league JSON import; trait bitmasks; relationships
- **docs/course_implementation_specification.md** — Course-derived implementation spec: FSM blueprints, physics formulas (passing kinematics, GK patrol, dot-product aerial aiming), data models, 10-phase build order, known gotchas table, and AI agent session protocol. READ-ONLY.
- **autoloads/DataLoader.gd** — JSON parsing; player/manager/team instantiation

## Static Analysis

- **tools/gdcheck.py** — Static GDScript checker; catches undeclared members, unknown types, Godot 3 APIs
- **Verify:** `python3 tools/gdcheck.py` (run after every file write)

## Directory Map

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `autoloads/` | Singletons; spatial cache, event bus, game state |
| `entities/player/` | HeavyPlayerController, brain, state machine, decision trees |
| `entities/ball/` | Pseudo3DBall, physics solver, possession state |
| `entities/manager/` | Formation library, director, tactical AI |
| `entities/referee/` | Match rules, personality-weighted decisions |
| `shared/` | Data models, math utilities, collision setup |
| `pitch/` | Field, boundaries, goal zones, markings |
| `ui/` | HUD, menus, pause, pre-game, screens |
| `tools/` | Static checkers, dev utilities |
| `.claude/` | Claude Code configuration, rules, skills |
| `docs/` | JSON schema, system documentation |

## First Steps for an Agent

1. Read **POWERFOOTBALL_MASTER_VISION.md** (vision, build order, context)
1b. Read **docs/course_implementation_specification.md** (build phases, formulas, agent protocol — consult before implementing any system from the course)
2. Read **ROADMAP.md** (current priorities)
3. Check **.claude/rules/** (three constraint files)
4. Identify target file in **autoloads/**, **entities/**, or **shared/**
5. Read that file's neighbors and upstream dependencies
6. Run `python3 tools/gdcheck.py` after every edit
7. Never cache stale architecture; re-read vision if context drift suspected
